   "source": [
    "# Segmentation\n",
    "\n",
    "A segmenter splits an image into masks, one per object or region. Masks clean up patch\n",
    "features: averaging the features inside each mask gives one clear feature per object. This page\n",
    "runs MobileSAM on one frame, pools Talk2DINO features in its masks, and shows the sky mask the\n",
    "mesh stage uses."
   ]
  },

    "import contextlib\n",
    "import io\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import transformers\n",
    "from PIL import Image\n",
    "\n",
    "from collab_splats.semantics import (\n",
    "    MobileSAMSegmentation,\n",
    "    Talk2DinoExtractor,\n",
    "    aggregate_masked_features,\n",

    "\n",
    "# One frame at 1024 px\n",
    "image = open_image(QUERY_IMAGE)\n",
    "frame = np.asarray(resize_image(image, 1024).convert(\"RGB\"))"
   ]

    "## 1. Two ways to prompt SAM\n",
    "\n",
    "- `object`: a detector finds objects, then SAM draws one mask per object, down to small litter.\n",
    "- `auto`: SAM is prompted with a grid of points, so it also masks large regions like the ground.\n",
    "\n",
    "Segment the frame both ways:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "b3cad9fa",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {

    "masks = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "for strategy in (\"object\", \"auto\"):\n",
    "    # Hide model-loading output\n",
    "    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):\n",
    "        segmenter = MobileSAMSegmentation(strategy=strategy, device=\"cuda\")\n",
    "        masks[strategy], _ = segmenter.segment(frame)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"{strategy}: {len(masks[strategy])} masks\")\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5), subplot_kw=BARE, layout=\"constrained\")\n",
    "\n",
    "for ax, strategy in zip(axes, masks):\n",
    "    ax.imshow(overlay_masks(frame, masks[strategy]))\n",
    "    ax.set_title(strategy)"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "25df97a4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Each color is one mask. `object` covers trunks, logs and small items but not the ground; `auto`\n",
    "also covers the ground. Neither masks the sky.\n",
    "\n",
    "## 2. Pooling features per mask\n",
    "\n",
    "`aggregate_masked_features` averages the features inside each mask and paints the average back\n",
    "over the mask. Where masks overlap, the later one wins; pixels in no mask get zero.\n",
    "\n",
    "Pool Talk2DINO features in the `object` masks:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "b727a472",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-09T07:00:58.763770Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-09T07:00:58.762662Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-09T07:01:05.923860Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-09T07:01:05.921736Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [

     "data": {
      "image/png": "",

       "<Figure size 1400x500 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "features = Talk2DinoExtractor().forward([frame])[0]\n",
    "patch_grid = tuple(features.shape[1:])\n",
    "pooled = aggregate_masked_features(\n",
    "    features, masks[\"object\"], resolution=patch_grid, final_resolution=patch_grid\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "panels = {\"patch features (PCA colors)\": features, \"pooled per object mask\": pooled}\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5), subplot_kw=BARE, layout=\"constrained\")\n",
    "\n",
    "for ax, (title, fmap) in zip(axes, panels.items()):\n",
    "    ax.imshow(pca_to_rgb(fmap, frame))\n",
    "    ax.set_title(title)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3de28055",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Similar colors mean similar features. On the left, colors vary patch by patch within an object;\n",
    "on the right, each object is one flat color.\n",
    "\n",
    "## 3. Sky masks\n",
    "\n",
    "The mesh stage removes sky before fusing depth (`mesh.mask_sky`). `sky_masks` gives each pixel a\n",
    "sky probability and keeps pixels above 0.5. It reads a folder of keyframes, so the frame is saved\n",
    "into one first."
   ]
  },
